decisions.title: Merge draft PR #40 (the coordinated Cortex architecture branch) into main
decisions.recommendation: Merge only after Linux CI is green and the decision-required items below are accepted or split out; merging deploys nothing

decisions.title: Deploy after merge (brain-jobs, orchestrator incl. control-plane shadow support, wind-hourly, water-clarity-brain)
decisions.recommendation: Deploy only with the lineage preflight; the Lake image stays on its own lineage

decisions.title: Read-only production checks: deployed image contents, bucket pointers, scheduler state
decisions.recommendation: Approve before A-2; turns NOT_VERIFIED production cells into evidence

decisions.title: Adopt packaged knowledge releases: runtimes verify their release manifest on load and refuse missing or tampered memory; the manifest is added to the Wind, Clarity and orchestrator images
decisions.recommendation: Accept (implemented locally, isolated commits 4ac482e6, 78d55294); takes effect only on an approved deploy

decisions.title: Fish: a missing or corrupt bundle now exits 2 with REFUSED instead of a traceback (exit 1)
decisions.recommendation: Accept (19e9824c); the orchestrator treats every nonzero exit as not published

decisions.title: Name the approver and record an approval for each knowledge release (all are NOT_RECORDED)
decisions.recommendation: Name an approver per Brain; the manifest then points at the record

decisions.title: Release lineage in legacy RTDB outputs (today only in SHADOW artifacts)
decisions.recommendation: Keep it in SHADOW artifacts until the Publisher cutover; no legacy output change

decisions.title: Clarity private overlay: digest-verify it as a private release, or keep it as optional detail
decisions.recommendation: Make it a private release with a digest when the overlay is next updated

decisions.title: Clarity repo-relative polygon fallback outside the image
decisions.recommendation: Remove it in a Clarity session (behaviour outside the image changes)

decisions.title: Lake presence release uses an FNV-1a fingerprint, not a cryptographic digest
decisions.recommendation: Switch to sha256 with the Lake owner on the Lake image lineage

decisions.title: Scorer rubrics staged into the orchestrator image are not digest-verified
decisions.recommendation: Add a release manifest over the staged rubric files without moving them (rubric files must never move)

decisions.title: Promote Depth and Vegetation knowledge (candidate releases) to APPROVED releases
decisions.recommendation: Requires scientific validation approval plus owner approval (PROJECT §7); until then both runtimes abstain (structure is complete)

decisions.title: Vegetation agency block publishes FWC percentages and SFWMD species-level labels (internalOnly)
decisions.recommendation: Withhold or reduce to presence before any release approval (surface-only V1 rule)

decisions.title: Kit V1 harness additions (has_score spec field; carried-finding mutation only when findings exist)
decisions.recommendation: Accept and upstream to the Kit's canonical source (CG-2.1-6)

decisions.title: Score measurement labels (Proposal A) and Wind score copy (Proposal B)
Water Clarity C1 job in the control manifest job map
decisions.recommendation: Allow MANUAL jobs in the map

decisions.title: Lake tooling move and data classification
decisions.recommendation: Schedule with the Lake research lane

decisions.title: Publish the sanitized Ops projection (engineering-status-ops-v1) to the Brain RTDB node /control/engineeringStatusV1 from main's CI artifact
decisions.recommendation: Approve the production write, the ownership entry for that node and (if from GitHub Actions) a CI write identity; no Ops rules change is needed. Until then nothing is published
